name: 92262 · Palm Springs, CA
findings: ZIP 92262 (Palm Springs) has 148 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92262 (Palm Springs) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92262 (Palm Springs) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 56 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
